description: The bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors across four different question-answering systems—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MusiQue, and IIRC—under three distinct configurations: NoR QA (orange bars), OneR QA (red bars), and IRGoT QA (blue bars). The vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled from 0 to 40 in increments of 5, while the horizontal axis lists the four datasets. For each dataset, the three bars are grouped together, with the legend indicating the corresponding system. The chart shows that the NoR QA system consistently results in the highest number of factual errors across all four datasets, with values of 15 for HotpotQA, 29 for 2WikiMQA, 28 for MusiQue, and 15 for IIRC. The OneR QA system produces fewer errors than NoR QA, with values of 10, 23, 27, and 14, respectively. The IRGoT QA system consistently produces the fewest errors, with values of 8, 14, 23, and 11. The data reveals that the IRGoT QA system achieves the lowest error count in all four datasets, while the NoR QA system has the highest.
